copy.headline: Landmark Commission approves 9 waivers for new Stockyards boutique hotel
copy.caption:
The hotel will be located at North Main and Northeast 23rd streets and include a two-story commercial building. A new 70-room boutique hotel and commercial project near the southern entrance of the Stockyards received waivers needed for development.

The Fort Worth Historic and Cultural Landmark Commission on Nov. 9 approved nine requested waivers for the project located at the corner of North Main and Northeast 23rd streets.
